_how_to_use: Copy everything inside 'experiment' and paste it as a new item in the 'experiments' list in experiments.json. Give it a unique id (lowercase, no spaces) and number. Set 'verify' to null unless a reference function exists for this id in backend/tools.py (REFERENCE dictionary). Restart the server after editing.

experiment.title: Experiment title from your lab manual
experiment.topic: Arithmetic | Arrays | String Operations | Interfacing | Code Conversion
experiment.aim: To write an 8086 assembly language program to ...
apparatus: PC with MASM/TASM + DOSBox, or emu8086
